Subject: Joint ISV accelerator workshop + hands-on track?

Hi Sofia,

Hope you're well — Liam from DevLoop here. We built a small partner program for ISVs focused on 0->1 embedded integrations and we'd love to run a joint workshop + hands-on track with Redwood at our next regional developer roadshow (SF, last week of August).

High level: one 30-min joint demo (Redwood + DevLoop) followed by a 60-min hands-on lab where attendees break into small groups and follow guided integration exercises. Target audience: product/engineering leads at mid-market ISVs evaluating inference platforms.

Questions for you:
- Would Redwood be interested in co-hosting and supplying 1-2 engineers to co-run the lab?
- Any constraints on logos/marketing copy or procurement requirements we should be aware of?
- We can share a one-pager — attaching our proposal (DevLoop-proposal.pdf).

We have a tentative 8/26 date at a co-working space in SF. If that doesn't work, 9/9 is a fallback. Would love to hop on a 30-min sync this week to align.

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
Partnerships, DevLoop
liam@devloop.io

Thanks Liam — this sounds promising and aligned with our field motion. Happy to co-host. Quick answers and ask list below.

TL;DR: Redwood can provide one 30-min product demo + two engineers to run the 60-min hands-on lab. We prefer 8/26 if we can lock speakers and venue this week.

Ask from our side:
- Can you share the attendee profile + expected count (typically we prefer <=60 for effective lab splits).
- Speaker names and short bios (so we can prepare a co-branded promo).
- Any procurement/SOW or invoice cadence? We usually do a simple MSA + event SOW for cost splits.

Logistics/ops:
- Proposed format: 30m joint demo (product/architecture), 60m hands-on (guided labs in small groups), 15m informal networking/Q&A.
- We have a draft agenda attached (joint-agenda-v1.pdf) — feel free to annotate.
- Marketing: Marissa (cc) will handle co-marketing cadence; Ben (cc) — please confirm if there are promotional credits we can offer to registrants.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for tomorrow with Ben and Marissa. If 8/26 works, we should lock speakers this week.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Head, Alliances & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
